name: CENNETIC 6075 Turn-Mill Machining Center
summary: The CENNETIC 6075 is a turn-mill machining centre using a straight-Y (direct-Y) layout that aligns the Y-axis guideway, slide and spindle in one line for a short force path and long support span. The result is a rigid, chatter-resistant platform for combined turning and milling of shaft and disc parts in copper, aluminium, cast iron, steel and titanium.
body:
The CENNETIC 6075 is a turn-mill machining centre using a straight-Y (direct-Y) layout that aligns the Y-axis guideway, slide and spindle in one line for a short force path and long support span. The result is a rigid, chatter-resistant platform for combined turning and milling of shaft and disc parts in copper, aluminium, cast iron, steel and titanium.

Equipment

Standard equipment

  • System — Open bus servo communication — Mechatrolink-III / EtherCAT
  • System — High-speed spindle orientation
  • System — Optimised drill / tap retract (shortened G00)

Optional equipment

  • Parts receiver
  • Chip conveyor
  • 90° live tool holder (C-axis)
  • Automatic bar feeder
  • 30 kg high-pressure coolant pump
  • Anti-collision system
  • Lathe tool setter

About this model

This Turn-Mill Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
